header: The three rules we argue about on every job
subheadline: When a deadline and a decision collide, these settle it. They are painted on the wall of the Lisbon studio, they are read out at every kickoff, and between them they have cost us two contracts we would take back.

value_items.title: Watch before you draw
value_items.description: No screen leaves the studio until someone here has watched the work it replaces being done by hand, on site.

value_items.title: Accessible or unfinished
value_items.description: Contrast, focus order and keyboard paths get checked at every critique, not in an audit three weeks before launch.

value_items.title: Hand over everything
value_items.description: Clients keep the research recordings, the component files and the prototypes. Nothing is held back to protect a renewal.
